title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees around the X-axis, zero degrees around the Y-axis, and negative ninety degrees around the Z-axis. Ensure the translation vector is set to [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch of a rectangle. The first line starts at the origin [0.0, 0.0] and ends at [0.0278, 0.0]. The second line starts at [0.0278, 0.0] and ends at [0.0278, 0.0119]. The third line starts at [0.0278, 0.0119] and ends at [0.0, 0.0119]. Finally, the fourth line starts at [0.0, 0.0119] and returns to the origin [0.0, 0.0]. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0278 to the sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the sketch using the Euler angles defined in the coordinate system and translate it using the specified translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from this extrusion to form the final rectangular prism. The final dimensions of the part are 0.0278 meters in length, 0.0119 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0278, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0278, 0.0119) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0119) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles (-90, 0, -90) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
# The translation vector is [0, 0, 0], so no translation is needed
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
